name: CyThing
description: ESP32 smart-device firmware as a library: Wi-Fi pairing over BLE or soft-AP, TCP/UDP local control, AWS IoT MQTT with per-device certificate provisioning, HTTPS OTA. Include CyThingEsp32.h, call cything_begin() from setup(), implement the two command hooks.
keywords: esp32, iot, mqtt, aws, ota, provisioning, ble
